manifest.name: @linbin-mk/dsh-workspace-prompt
manifest.description: Third-party DeepSeek Harness plugin: per-workspace custom prompt configured from a slash command and injected into the model context at session start.
manifest.author: linbin-mk (https://github.com/linbin-mk)

readme.text:
[English](https://github.com/linbin-mk/dsh-workspace-prompt/blob/main/README.en.md) | 简体中文

dsh-workspace-prompt

给每个工作区一段专属提示词。
写一次、打开开关，这个工作区的每个新会话都会带上它；每个会话第一次带上之前，只问你一次。
> 纯第三方 DeepSeek Harness 插件，不改 Harness 源码；界面只在 Web Client 提供。

同一个 Harness 里常常并排开着好几个仓库：前端要 pnpm 和中文提交信息，后端要 Gradle，文档库只想要简洁回答。把这些规则塞进每次对话既啰嗦又容易漏；写进全局提示词，又会串到别的项目里。

`dsh-workspace-prompt` 把提示词挂到**工作区**上：

- **按工作区隔离** —— 以会话的绝对工作目录（`cwd`）为 key，不同工作区互不影响。
- **默认不注入** —— 保存只是存下来；打开输入框工具行的开关，才真正进入模型上下文。
- **每个会话只问一次** —— 第一次真正要注入时弹一张确认卡；选「不带」的会话不再询问、也不再注入，开关状态不变。
- **重启不丢** —— 提示词与开关保存在插件 `Config` 里，由 Harness 的 user-settings provider 写入 profile 用户层。
- **与 `AGENTS.md` 共存** —— 复用官方 `agent-instructions` 的注入形态，transcript 里显示为折叠的「上下文注入」行，而不是用户气泡。
在任意会话里输入 `/workspace-prompt`，选择 **配置工作区提示词**。命令只在当前会话绑定了 `cwd` 时出现。 弹窗会回显已存的值；**保存** 写入该工作区，**清除** 连同开关状态一起删除。

readme.section: ② 打开输入框工具行的开关
readme.text: 保存后，输入框工具行出现「**工作区提示词-关**」；点一下变成「**工作区提示词-开**」并带一层浅灰底色（与输入框里 `⊕` 按钮同一个灰）。没有任何提示词的工作区不会出现这个开关。

readme.section: ③ 每个会话首次发送时确认一次
readme.text: 开关打开后，某个会话第一次真正需要注入时会出现这张卡： - **带上** —— 选项后面直接列出该工作区配置的提示词，选了就并入本会话的模型上下文； - **不带** —— 本会话不再询问、也不再注入，**开关保持原状**（下个会话会重新问一次）。 卡片文案只显示一种语言，跟随 DSH 的界面语言：设置里选过语言就按它来，没选过则按宿主系统语言（本地 `dsh web` 下与浏览器的默认语言一致）。 确认卡走官方 `ctx.userQuestions` 通道（审批、计划评审用的是同一个通道），所以它会出现在该会话里，并且这一步会等你回答后才继续。
**设置 → 工作区提示词** 用一张工作区列表集中管理：已配置的按名称排在前面（提示词预览、开关、展开箭头），中间用「未配置的工作区」分割行隔开，未配置的只读展示；点行就地展开编辑器，保存 / 清除都在编辑器内完成，右上角仍是原来的 **添加工作区** 菜单。

把已发布的包安装进自定义 Web profile。产物不含指向 Harness checkout 的路径依赖，`dsh.bundle` patch 会自动加入 Host 和 Client 插件行：

```sh
dsh --profile web-prompt --from-default-profile web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile web-prompt add @linbin-mk/dsh-workspace-prompt
dsh --profile web-prompt
```

改为安装本地构建的 tarball：

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build          # tsc 产出 lib/types/*.d.ts；tsdown 产出 lib/index.js + lib/client.js
pnpm pack
dsh plugin --profile web-prompt add ./linbin-mk-dsh-workspace-prompt-<version>.tgz
包声明了 `dsh.client` 入口，插件进入组合树后 web shell 会自动加载 `lib/client.js`；node 端 `lib/index.js` 负责声明可实时编辑的 `Config` 并在 `agent/pre-step` 注入提示词。

1. 打开要配置的工作区里的任意会话；
2. 输入 `/workspace-prompt`，选择 **配置工作区提示词**，写好内容后点 **保存**；
3. 在输入框工具行点击「工作区提示词」，标签从 `-关` 变为 `-开`；
4. 正常发消息；本会话第一次需要注入时，在确认卡上选 **带上** 或 **不带**；
5. 不再需要时，关掉开关，或在弹窗 / 设置页点 **清除**。

| 项目 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 作用域 | 提示词与开关都以会话的绝对工作目录（`cwd`）为 key；会话的 `cwd` 必须与设置页里的工作区路径完全一致。 |
| 默认状态 | 关闭。没有提示词的工作区不显示开关，输入框工具行与原生完全一样。 |
| 注入时机 | 开关打开后，在 `agent/pre-step` 钩子里注入；每一步先检查该内容是否已在会话上下文中，避免重复。 |
| 会话确认 | 每个会话只在首次真正注入时问一次。选过「带上」的会话，如果提示词文本变了、或上下文被压缩掉，会直接用最新文本重新注入，不再询问。 |
| 持久化 | 存在插件 `Config` 的 `prompts` / `enabled` 两个可实时编辑字段里，由 Harness 的 settings provider 落到 profile 用户层。 |
| 无提问通道时 | profile 没有 `userQuestions`、headless 运行、子代理或被托管（`DELEGATED_CALLER`）时，退回开关语义直接注入；用户关闭/忽略（`ASK_CANCELLED`）视作本轮「不带」。 |
| 生效时机 | 改动从下一步生效：中途打开开关，当前会话的下一次请求就会带上；中途改文本，下一次请求追加新文本，历史里更早的值不变。 |

- Node.js `^22.19` 或 `>=24`；
- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.3` 或兼容的 `0.2.1` 预发布版本，以及提供 `ctx.settings` / `ctx.configForms` / `ctx.agent` 的 Web profile；会话首次确认还需要 `ctx.userQuestions`（Web profile 默认含 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-user-questions`，缺失时退回开关语义）；
- 本包只在 Web Client 端提供界面，不提供终端或桌面端入口。

readme.section: Host 端（`src/index.ts` + `src/inject.ts`，作为 Cordis 插件加载）
readme.text:
- 声明 Cordis `Config`：`prompts: Record<absoluteDir, string>` 与 `enabled: Record<absoluteDir, boolean>`，都标记为 `.volatile()`，因此可以在设置表单里实时编辑。loader 行 id `workspace-prompt` 就是它的 settings 命名空间，Host 侧改动由 Harness 的 settings provider 落到 profile 用户层并实时推给插件。插件自带设置页，因此 `apply` 里用 `ctx.settings.configure({ auto: false })` 关掉自动生成的配置页。
- 监听 `agent/pre-step`。每一步读取会话的 `header.cwd`；**只有该工作区的 `enabled` 为 `true`** 时才去取 `prompts`。命中且该内容还没出现在会话上下文里时，先通过 `ctx.get('userQuestions')?.ask(...)` 问一次（每个会话只问一次，答案在整个会话里复用），选「带上」才生成一条包在 `<system-reminder>` 里的 `user/message`，在 agent inbox 中维护它，并并入该步的决策，使其进入首个模型请求与持久化日志。提问前按界面语言只生成一种文案，并把提示词原文放在「带上」选项的说明里。
- 纯注入、开关判定与 inbox 对账逻辑在 `src/inject.ts`（`promptFor` / `enabledFor`）；提问载荷与判定在 `src/confirm.ts`（`confirmQuestions` / `readInclude` / `SessionDecisions`）；文案语言的选择在 `src/language.ts`（优先 `locale.preference`，否则宿主系统语言）；`src/index.ts` 负责把它们接到 Cordis 上下文上。
- **问不到人时不阻塞**：没有 `userQuestions` 服务、没人能应答（headless 运行）、当前 agent 是子代理或被托管（`DELEGATED_CALLER`）时，插件退回开关语义直接注入。

readme.section: Client 端（`src/client/index.ts`，作为插件的 `dsh.client` 半加载）
readme.text:
- 注册名为 `workspace-prompt` 的 `CommandContribution`；斜杠菜单项仅在当前会话有 `cwd` 时出现。
- 注册一个 `shell.overlay` 模态框（`WorkspacePromptModal`），接到一个小的 `HostObservable` 上。选择该命令时通过共享配置表单（`ctx.configForms.get('workspace-prompt')`，entry id 与 loader 行 id 一致）读取当前值并打开模态框；表单不可写（未就绪或 Host 拒绝写入）时，保存/清除按钮保持禁用。
- **保存 / 清除** 通过同一个共享配置表单回写（`form.mutate`，对 `prompts.<cwd>` 执行 `set` / `unset` 路径操作；清除会同时 `unset` `enabled.<cwd>`；Host 拒绝时表单返回 `false`，界面按失败提示），因此回显的值与注入的值共用同一数据源。
- 注册输入框工具行的开关（`conversation.input.left`，`WorkspacePromptToggle`）：用 `useSessions` 取当前会话的 `cwd`，只在状态里存在该工作区的提示词时渲染；点击写 `enabled.<cwd>`。两态是同一个 chip 的两种底色与两种标签：关闭 = 透明底 + 次要文字色 + `-关`，开启 = `--dsw-specific-selector` 浅灰底 + 主文字色 + `-开`。写失败、配置只读、以及 **Host 半仍是升级前版本** 时，控件用 `aria-disabled` + 变灰而不是真 `disabled`（真 disabled 会吞掉 tooltip），悬停时说明原因。
- 注册 **设置 → 工作区提示词** 总览页（`settings.section`）。页面是一张工作区列表：已配置的按名称排在前面、显示提示词预览与开关，未配置的以只读行排在「未配置的工作区」分割行之后；点行就地展开编辑器，保存 / 清除在编辑器内完成。**添加工作区** 下拉的数据来自 `useWorkspaces` 标准钩子，只列出尚未配置提示词的已注册工作区。页面同样订阅共享配置表单：写入结果与 Host 侧变更都会立即反映到列表，表单未就绪或不可写时所有写入控件禁用。页面样式是 `WorkspacePromptsSection.module.css`，构建时内联进 client bundle 并自动加 `wsp-` 前缀。

readme.section: 为什么入口是斜杠命令，而不是工作区「更多」弹出菜单
readme.text: `packages/client/ui-workspace` 里的工作区操作菜单（`重命名` / `删除工作区`）在 `Rows.tsx` 中是硬编码的，**没有留给菜单项的 slot 或扩展点**。不改 Harness 源码的插件无法在那两行之间插入自己的项。本插件改用已有的 `commandUi` + `shell.overlay` 扩展点，无需改动 Harness。（如果你确实想让它出现在那个弹出菜单里，需要在 `ui-workspace` 加一行扩展点——属于改 Harness 源码。）

- 开关与提示词的改动都在下一步生效：中途打开开关，当前会话的下一次请求就会带上提示词；中途改文本，下一次请求追加新文本，历史里更早的值保持不变。
- 模态框入口是斜杠命令，不是工作区「更多」弹出菜单（见上文）。
- 本包要求 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.3` 或兼容的 `0.2.1` 预发布版本（插件配置即 Cordis `Config`，浏览器侧通过 `ctx.configForms` 读写）。它是独立的第三方插件，不受 Harness `packages/*` 的测试/覆盖率门禁约束；集成效果必须在运行中的 Harness 中验证。
- 提示词只在开关打开时占用该工作区的上下文预算；写得越长，留给对话的空间越少。
- 开关按工作区记忆：在一个会话里打开，该工作区的其他会话（含之后新建的）也会带上提示词，直到再次关闭。
- 每个会话只问**首次**：选过「不带」的会话不会再问、也不会再注入（想在会话中途改主意，把开关关掉再打开即可——新会话自然重新问）。选过「带上」的会话若后来改了提示词文本、或上下文被压缩掉，会**直接**用最新文本重新注入，不再询问。
- 确认卡文案跟随 DSH 的界面语言，**只显示中文或英文中的一种**：优先读设置里的 `locale.preference`，没选过时按宿主系统语言判断（问题协议没有本地化通道，宿主只能在提问前二选一）；「带上」选项的说明直接展示该工作区配置的提示词。

- **斜杠菜单里没有这一项** —— 只有当前会话有 `cwd` 时才提供该命令；在未绑定工作区的会话里它不会出现。
- **提示词没有注入** —— 先看输入框工具行：开关默认是 `关`；没有这个开关就说明当前工作区还没配置提示词。开关是 `开` 时，再确认提示词保存在**当前会话所属工作区**的 key（绝对路径）下——会话的 `cwd` 与你在设置页看到的工作区路径必须完全一致。
- **输入框里没有这个开关** —— 该工作区尚未配置提示词（设计如此）；用 `/workspace-prompt` 或设置页先保存一段。
- **点了发送却没有出现确认卡** —— 说明这次发送本来就不需要注入：提示词已经在当前会话上下文里（只有真正要注入时才问），或者该 profile 没有 `userQuestions` 通道（headless / 子代理会话），此时按开关语义直接注入。
- **升级插件后开关点不动 / 只变灰** —— 浏览器里的 client 半是每次刷新从磁盘取的，Host 半只在进程启动时加载：`dsh plugin add` 之后必须**重启 `dsh web`**，否则旧的 Host 会拒绝新字段（插件会直接在开关上提示这一点）。重启后旧的提示词仍保持关闭状态，需要为各工作区重新打开开关。
- **重启后界面里没有插件** —— 用 `dsh --profile web-prompt --dump-config` 确认插件行已被组合进 profile；插件缺失时该行不会出现。

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build          # 构建 lib/（提交进仓库，随包发布）；client 样式模块内联进 bundle
pnpm test           # vitest run
```

`tests/manifest-identity.spec.ts` 断言 `package.json` 的 `name`、`cordis.patch.yml` 的 `insert[].name` 与 `tsdown.config.ts` 里的 `PLUGIN_ID`（banner 与样式注入共用它）三者一致——改名时它会变红，而不是安静地装上一个加载不起来的包。

English | [简体中文](https://github.com/linbin-mk/dsh-workspace-prompt/blob/main/README.md)

dsh-workspace-prompt

A dedicated prompt for every workspace.
Write it once, turn the switch on, and every new session in that workspace carries it — after being asked once per session.
> A pure third-party DeepSeek Harness plugin: it changes no Harness source, and its UI ships on the Web Client only.

One Harness session list often spans several repositories: the frontend wants pnpm and Chinese commit messages, the backend wants Gradle, the docs repo just wants short answers. Repeating those rules in every conversation is noisy and easy to forget; putting them in a global system prompt leaks them into every project.

`dsh-workspace-prompt` attaches the prompt to the **workspace** instead:

- **Scoped per workspace** — keyed by the session's absolute working directory (`cwd`), so workspaces never bleed into each other.
- **Off by default** — saving only stores the text; the prompt reaches the model context after you turn on the switch in the composer tool row.
- **Ask once per session** — the first time a session would actually inject it, a confirmation card appears. A session that answers "skip" is never asked again and never injected, and the switch state stays untouched.
- **Survives restarts** — the prompt and the switch live in the plugin's `Config`, written to the profile's user layer by the Harness user-settings provider.
- **Composes with `AGENTS.md`** — it reuses the injection shape of the official `agent-instructions`, so the transcript renders a collapsed context-injection row rather than a user bubble.

readme.section: 1. Configure it with a slash command
readme.text: Type `/workspace-prompt` in any session and pick **配置工作区提示词**. The command is only offered when the session has a `cwd`.

readme.section: 1. Configure it with a slash command
readme.text: The modal echoes the stored value; **Save** writes it, **Clear** removes the prompt together with the switch state.

readme.section: 2. Turn on the switch in the composer tool row
readme.text: Once a prompt is saved, the composer tool row shows **工作区提示词-关** (workspace prompt, off). One click turns it into **工作区提示词-开** over a light gray fill (the same gray as the composer's `⊕` button). A workspace without a prompt shows no switch at all.
With the switch on, the first time a session actually needs injection it shows this card:

- **Include** — shows the workspace's own prompt right after the label, so you can see exactly what enters this session's model context;
- **Skip** — this session is never asked again and never injected, and **the switch stays as it is** (the next session asks again).

The card renders one language only, following the DSH UI language: an explicit language chosen in Settings wins, and a browser that never chose one is followed through the Host system language (the browser's default in a local `dsh web` deployment).

The card rides the official `ctx.userQuestions` channel (the same one approvals and plan review use), so it appears inside that session and the step waits for your answer.

**Settings → 工作区提示词** keeps everything in one workspace list: configured workspaces come first, sorted by title, with a prompt preview and arm switch; a **Workspaces without a prompt** divider separates the read-only remainder. Clicking a row opens its editor in place, with Save and Clear inside it; the **Add workspace** menu in the card header keeps the original add flow.

Install the published package into a custom Web profile. The artifact contains no path dependency on a Harness checkout, and its `dsh.bundle` patch adds the Host and Client plugin rows automatically:

```sh
dsh --profile web-prompt --from-default-profile web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile web-prompt add @linbin-mk/dsh-workspace-prompt
dsh --profile web-prompt
```

Or install a locally built tarball:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build          # tsc emits lib/types/*.d.ts; tsdown emits lib/index.js + lib/client.js
pnpm pack
dsh plugin --profile web-prompt add ./linbin-mk-dsh-workspace-prompt-<version>.tgz

Because the package declares a `dsh.client` entry, the web shell loads `lib/client.js` automatically once the plugin is part of the composed tree; the node half (`lib/index.js`) declares the live-editable `Config` and injects the prompt at `agent/pre-step`.

1. Open any session inside the workspace you want to configure.
2. Type `/workspace-prompt`, pick **配置工作区提示词**, write the prompt and click **保存**.
3. Click **工作区提示词** in the composer tool row; the label flips from `-关` to `-开`.
4. Send messages as usual; the first time the session needs injection, answer **带上** or **不带** on the confirmation card.
5. When you no longer need it, turn the switch off, or click **清除** in the modal / settings page.

| Item | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Scope | Both the prompt and the switch are keyed by the session's absolute working directory (`cwd`); the session's `cwd` must match the workspace path shown in Settings exactly. |
| Default state | Off. A workspace without a prompt shows no switch, and the composer tool row stays exactly as it was. |
| Injection timing | With the switch on, injection happens in the `agent/pre-step` hook; every step first checks whether the payload is already in the session context, so it is never duplicated. |
| Session confirmation | Each session is asked once, the first time injection is actually needed. A session that answered "include" re-injects the newest text directly — without asking — if the text changes or compaction drops it. |
| Persistence | Stored in the plugin `Config` fields `prompts` / `enabled`, both live-editable, and written to the profile's user layer by the Harness settings provider. |
| No question channel | Without a `userQuestions` service, in headless runs, or with a child / managed agent (`DELEGATED_CALLER`), the plugin falls back to the switch's standing intent and injects; a dismissal (`ASK_CANCELLED`) counts as this turn's skip. |

readme.section: Host half (`src/index.ts` + `src/inject.ts`, loaded as a Cordis plugin)
readme.text:
- Declares its Cordis `Config`: `prompts: Record<absoluteDir, string>` and `enabled: Record<absoluteDir, boolean>`, both marked `.volatile()` so the settings form can edit them live. Its loader row id `workspace-prompt` is the settings namespace; the Harness settings provider writes Host-side changes to the profile's user layer and pushes them to the plugin. The plugin ships its own settings page, so `apply` turns the generated config page off with `ctx.settings.configure({ auto: false })`.
- Listens on `agent/pre-step`. For each step it reads the session's `header.cwd` and only then — **when that workspace's `enabled` is `true`** — looks the prompt up. When that payload is not already in the session context, it first asks through `ctx.get('userQuestions')?.ask(...)` (once per session; the answer stands for the whole session); only an **Include** answer mints a `user/message` wrapped in `<system-reminder>`, manages it in the agent inbox, and folds it into the step's decision so it reaches the first model request and the durable log. Before asking, it renders the copy in one UI language and puts the raw prompt in the Include option's description.
- The pure switch check, injection,

readme.text:
- Registers a `CommandContribution` named `workspace-prompt`. The slash menu entry is only offered when the current session has a `cwd`.
- Registers a `shell.overlay` modal (`WorkspacePromptModal`) wired to a small `HostObservable`. Selecting the command reads the current value through the shared configuration form (`ctx.configForms.get('workspace-prompt')`, whose entry id is the loader row id) and opens the modal; when the form refuses writes (not ready, or the Host document rejects the write), Save and Clear stay disabled.
- **Save** / **Clear** call back through the same shared configuration form (`form.mutate` with `set` / `unset` path ops on `prompts.<cwd>`; clearing also unsets `enabled.<cwd>`; a Host refusal answers `false` and the UI reports the failure), so the echoed value and the injected value share one source.

readme.section: Why the entry is a slash command, not the workspace "more" popup
readme.text: The workspace action popup (`重命名` / `删除工作区`) in `packages/client/ui-workspace` is hardcoded in `Rows.tsx` with **no slot or extension point** for menu items. A source-unchanged plugin therefore cannot insert an item between those two rows. This plugin uses the existing `commandUi` + `shell.overlay` extension points instead, which need no Harness changes. (If you want it literally in that popup, that requires a one-line extension point in `ui-workspace` — a Harness source change.)

- Switch and prompt changes apply from the next step: turning the switch on mid-session adds the prompt to that session's next request, and editing the text appends the new value while the earlier one stays in history.
- The modal entry point is the slash command, not the workspace "more" popup (see above).
- This package requires DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.3` or a compatible `0.2.1` prerelease (plugin configuration is Cordis `Config`, and the browser half reads and writes it through `ctx.configForms`). It is an independent third-party plugin and is not covered by the Harness `packages/*` test / coverage gates; integration must be verified in a running Harness.
- A prompt consumes context budget only while the switch is on, so the longer it is, the less room is left for the conversation.
- The switch is remembered per workspace: turning it on in one session arms the workspace's other sessions (including later ones) until it is turned off again.
- Each session is asked **once**: a session that answered "skip" is never asked again and never injected (to change your mind mid-session, turn the switch off and on again — a new session asks fresh). A session that answered "include" re-inj

- **The slash menu does not offer the command** — it is only offered when the current session has a `cwd`; an unbound session never shows it.
- **The prompt is not injected** — look at the composer tool row first: the switch defaults to `OFF`, and its absence means this workspace has no prompt yet. With the switch `ON`, check that the prompt is stored under the key (absolute path) of the workspace the session actually runs in. The session's `cwd` and the workspace path shown on the settings page must match exactly.
- **The composer shows no switch** — this workspace has no configured prompt yet (by design); save one with `/workspace-prompt` or from the settings page.
- **Sending shows no confirmation** — that send needed no decision: the prompt already stands in this session's context (the question appears only when it would actually be injected), or the profile composes no `userQuestions` channel (headless / child-agent sessions), where the switch's standing intent applies directly.
- **After upgrading the plugin the switch is inert or only greys out** — the browser half is fetched from disk on every page load while the Host half is loaded at process start: after `dsh plugin add`

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build          # builds lib/ (committed and shipped); client styles are inlined into the bundle
pnpm test           # vitest run
```

`tests/manifest-identity.spec.ts` asserts that `package.json`'s `name`, the `insert[].name` in `cordis.patch.yml`, and `PLUGIN_ID` in `tsdown.config.ts` (shared by the bundle banner and the stylesheet injection) all agree — a rename turns it red instead of quietly installing a package that never loads.
